about: Every input of the MRZ model training, pinned. bin/00-setup.sh fetches the downloads into work/inputs and refuses any file whose SHA-256 differs; the repository files are checked the same way. None of these files is shipped: the model we ship is our own output (see README.md).

downloads.name: tesstrain (Makefile and list helpers)
downloads.use: make unicharset, lists, proto-model and the .lstmf files

downloads.name: langdata_lstm radical-stroke.txt
downloads.use: character property table read by combine_lang_model (proto model)

downloads.name: langdata_lstm Latin.unicharset
downloads.use: character properties of the Latin script (proto model); our 37 characters are A-Z, 0-9 and <

downloads.name: tessdata_fast eng.traineddata
downloads.use: lets native Tesseract run its line finding on prepared bands (node/cutLines.ts); only the geometry is kept, the text it reads is thrown away. Not a training input of the model.

downloads.name: tessdata_best eng.traineddata
downloads.licence: Apache-2.0 (trained by Google on synthetic renders in about 4,500 fonts, many commercial: see README.md)
downloads.use: fallback run 2 only (bin/31-finetune.sh): the starting weights of the fine-tune. Not fetched unless asked (bin/00-setup.sh --finetune)

repository.name: OCR-B font (Matthew Skala's OCR fonts 0.3.1)
repository.licence: Schwarz: free use without limitation; Skala: no copyright claimed (scripts/fonts/ocr-b/README.md)
repository.use: draws every MRZ character of the training data and the benchmarks

repository.name: MRZ fixture renderer
repository.use: the G2/G3 benchmark's documents (py/bench.py), a renderer the training data never used
repository.onMismatch: warn: the benchmark changes with it, so results from before and after are not comparable

repository.name: Doubango mrz.traineddata (the model in use today)
repository.use: the G1/G3 baseline only; never a training input

python: training/mrz/pyproject.toml and uv.lock (Pillow 12.3.0 and NumPy 2.5.3 wheels, hashes in the lock)
node: the repository's package-lock.json (tesseract.js 7.0.0, tesseract.js-core 7.0.0, Vite for node/run.mjs)

tools.tesseract: Tesseract 5.3.4 with its training tools (lstmtraining, lstmeval, combine_tessdata, combine_lang_model, unicharset_extractor): Ubuntu 24.04 package tesseract-ocr 5.3.4-1build5. Build tool only, never shipped (see README.md, Licences).
tools.make: GNU Make 4.2 or later (tesstrain needs it)
